limitations.PhiBench: The 206 EFF-Dock cases are locally selected from the released archive; identity with the published PhysDock 206 has not been established. PAL means protein-aligned ligand RMSD in the cited preprint. The historical atom correspondence, symmetry policy, 18-criterion PB conjunction and software version are not fully established; these are not equated to the current symmetry-corrected RMSD or 27 checks. Retrieved source Supplementary Table 2 resolves comparator numerators and evaluable denominators (180--206), not correspondence to the local 206-case cohort. Only eight pocket-conditioned rows marked in source Figure 2 are included; sequence-only rows in the same source supplementary table are omitted. Source-reported missing cases are not reclassified or imputed.
limitations.FoldBench: All 558 released interface identities map exactly to each EFF-Dock repeat. The original evaluation pins OpenStructure 2.8.0. The released group does not certify each source model's defined-score denominator; cofolding and fixed-holo redocking remain different tasks and preparation protocols.
limitations.OpenBind: The official 802-complex follow-on subset differs from the primary 925-complex cohort. The source rmsd_valid metric already includes PoseBusters validity. All 925 official IDs map one-to-one to EFF-Dock by case normalization, but metric and preparation equivalence remain unproven.

additional_sources.purpose: Original FoldBench evaluator environment pins OpenStructure 2.8.0, distinct from 2.11.1.
PhiBench pocket-conditioned comparator counts and method-specific denominators, Supplementary Table 2; native baseline preparation in Section 5.

openbind_subset_membership.rule: Reference PoseBusters-valid and not artefact and not fragment-screen, matching the official filtered follow-on group. Outcome-blind annotation rule; all 925 primary cases remain retained.

FoldBench.date_policy: Initial release date; accession prefixes and deposition dates are not substitutes.

construction.sequence: Archive-ordered concatenation of receptor-chain sequences; exact duplicate reduction followed by deterministic representatives of global-identity connected components.
construction.identity_normalization: Identical aligned residues divided by longer concatenated sequence length. This is not the binding-chain similarity used for training exposure.

protocol_notes.PhiBench: All source rows are pocket-conditioned Top-5 of 40; source PB is the reported conjunction, not equated to our 27 checks. EFF-Dock uses refined chirality-filtered selection on its local cohort, symmetry-aware fixed-receptor RMSD, and PB 0.6.5 pass-all. Prefix40 is a restriction of the saved100 bank, not independent generation or equal compute.
protocol_notes.FoldBench: Published source models predict the receptor and ligand; EFF-Dock is supplied-holo redocking. Same original OST2.8.0 structural conjunction, all558 EFF-Dock identities, but source per-model evaluability/preparation/training exposure not harmonized. Missing source RMSD-only rates remain null, not zero.
protocol_notes.OpenBind: Official802 follow-on cases; GNINA published holo redocking versus EFF-Dock saved100 Top1. Structural criteria align but preparation, PB implementation and budgets are not all harmonized.
